d: ACS Group is looking for an experienced Property Manager to lead and oversee an international portfolio of luxury residential properties across the UK, Europe, and the Middle East.
The portfolio includes a primary residence in London, seasonal residences in Cyprus, the UAE, and the Alps, as well as occasional involvement with properties in France, Switzerland, and Italy.

This is a senior leadership position focused on the strategic and operational oversight of multiple luxury residences. The successful candidate will lead an established household team, coordinate external contractors and professional advisors, oversee property-related projects, and ensure that all residences operate to the highest standards.

This role is particularly suited to a commercially minded professional who combines strong leadership capabilities, luxury hospitality experience, and extensive knowledge of residential property management.
q: Minimum 5 years of experience in luxury residential property management, preferably in a senior management or leadership position.
Strong knowledge of the London luxury residential property market.
Established professional network of premium contractors, suppliers, service providers, and real estate professionals.
Proven experience overseeing household teams or luxury hospitality operations.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple properties or complex residential operations.
Strong project management background, including renovations, refurbishment, and contractor management.
Experience with financial planning, budgeting, cost control, and reporting.
Excellent understanding of property regulations, compliance, and operational best practices.
Outstanding leadership, organisational, negotiation, and communication skills.
Currently based in London or willing to relocate.
Willingness and ability to travel internationally, particularly to the UAE, Cyprus, and other European destinations.
r: Oversee the overall management and operational performance of an international portfolio of luxury residential properties.
Establish and maintain exceptional operational and presentation standards across all residences.
Conduct regular property inspections to assess condition, maintenance requirements, compliance, and operational efficiency.

Ensure properties are maintained efficiently and cost-effectively.
Develop and implement procedures to improve property operations and service standards.

Lead recruitment, onboarding, training, and professional development of household employees.
Ensure effective communication and coordination between household teams across different locations.

Assess the condition of properties and establish priorities for maintenance, repairs, and improvements.
Oversee renovation, refurbishment, and property improvement projects.
Identify, evaluate, and appoint reliable contractors, suppliers, and external specialists.
Manage tenders, negotiate commercial terms, and ensure value for money.
Monitor project budgets, timelines, quality, and overall delivery.
Oversee ongoing projects, including a partial renovation of the primary London residence.
Oversee property budgets, operating expenses, and financial planning across the portfolio.
Ensure effective cost control and responsible allocation of resources.

Provide regular updates and reports on property operations, expenditure, and ongoing projects.
x: London-based position with responsibility for an international property portfolio.
